exposure: Registry (USA T1D Exchange vs. German/Austrian DPV)
cohort: The study participants were 18,381 individuals from the US T1D Exchange Registry and 32,643 individuals from the German/Austrian DPV Registry, all with type 1 diabetes.
finding: Significant differences in HbA1c levels were observed between people with type 1 diabetes in the USA and Germany/Austria across the lifespan, with disparities being more pronounced from early childhood through to young adulthood.
cross-section timing: Comparison of existing registry data across various age groups to analyze HbA1c levels across the lifespan.
